name: Biróg

attributes.attribute: was a druid and an Irish heroine
helped Cian enter dressed in women's clothes
was the daughter of Balor of the Evil Eye
was the father of the hero Lugh

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Biróg was an Irish heroine and a woman druid. In the tale of the hero Lugh, she helped a human named Cian. Cian was the father of Lugh. Biróg showed Cian how to wear women's clothing, and the disguise let him enter the prison of Eithne. Eithne was the daughter of Balor of the Evil Eye.

okr.objective: Explain the role of the druid Biróg in the story of Lugh's conception.
key_results: Biróg was a druid and Irish heroine.
She helped Cian, father of Lugh, enter disguised in women's garments.
The disguise let Cian reach Eithne, daughter of Balor of the Evil Eye.
